metadata.name: vicinity_launchpad
metadata.description: Vicinity Launchpad: one coin per city, launched on Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve, with the city's fee share routed to holders and founder

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Step two of the admin transfer, signed by the proposed key.

instructions.name: add_launch_config
docs: Allow-list a Meteora DBC config after checking every Vicinity rule.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: The Meteora config. `AccountLoader` checks that DBC owns it and that its
discriminator is `PoolConfig` (not a pool, not a transfer-hook config).

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: any non-SPL) mint gets the clear `QuoteMintNotAllowed` error of rule 2.

instructions.name: approve_launch
docs: Approve one founder to launch one city's coin under one allowed config.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin, who also pays the approval's rent (refunded when it closes).

accounts.name: coin
docs: owned by the System program). Lamports alone are fine.

instructions.name: claim_founder_fees
docs: The founder takes the whole founder vault.

accounts.name: founder
docs: Must be `coin.founder`; pays for its own token account if missing.

accounts.name: founder_token_account
docs: The founder's own associated token account for the quote token.

instructions.name: forward_holders_fees
docs: Permissionless: move the holders pot into the city's checked
`vicinity_rewards` vault.

accounts.name: rewards_city_config
docs: from the coin mint under the stored rewards program, the owner is that
program, and the handler reads and checks its fields.

accounts.name: rewards_vault
docs: The city's rewards vault: derived from the config under the rewards
program, holding the quote token, owned by the config PDA.

instructions.name: harvest_curve_fees
docs: Permissionless: claim the city's half of the curve trading fees and
split it into the holders pot and the founder vault.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the rent of `coin_base_account` the first time.

instructions.name: harvest_pool_fees
docs: Permissionless: the same for the graduated DAMM v2 pool position.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the rent of `coin_base_account` the first time.

accounts.name: damm_pool
docs: The DAMM v2 pool (owner and type checked by `AccountLoader`).

accounts.name: position
docs: A DAMM v2 position in `damm_pool` (owner and type checked).

accounts.name: position_nft_account
docs: holds `position.nft_mint`, belongs to the Coin PDA and holds exactly 1.

instructions.name: init_launchpad
docs: One-time: create the global `Launchpad` account. Only the program's
upgrade authority can call it, and the admin must sign.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Becomes `launchpad.admin`. Must sign (see the module comment).

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: Must be the program's current upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: this program id under the upgradeable loader and the owner is checked;
the handler reads the upgrade authority from its header.

accounts.name: rewards_program
docs: stored for ever, so this catches a typo.

instructions.name: launch
docs: The approved founder launches the city's coin (DBC creates the mint,
the fixed supply, the immutable metadata and the curve).

accounts.name: founder
docs: Must be the approved founder.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays every rent and the launch fee (usually the founder).

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: A fresh keypair: the new coin's address. DBC creates the mint.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: The allowed Meteora config named by the approval.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: The config's quote token (classic SPL Token, re-checked below).

instructions.name: opt_in_payout
docs: The founder opts in to payouts into the fixed payout wallet.

accounts.name: founder
docs: Must be `coin.founder`; pays the opt-in's rent (refunded on revoke).

instructions.name: payout_founder_fees
docs: The payout key sends an opted-in founder's vault to the fixed payout
wallet, at most once per 24 hours per coin.

accounts.name: payout_authority
docs: Must be `launchpad.payout_authority`; pays for the destination's token
account if missing.

accounts.name: destination_token_account
docs: The payout wallet's associated token account for the quote token.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Step one of the admin transfer (zero address cancels).

instructions.name: revoke_approval
docs: Close a pending approval; its rent goes back to whoever paid it.

instructions.name: revoke_payout_opt_in
docs: The founder (current, or the one who signed the opt-in) opts out.

accounts.name: by
docs: `coin.founder` or `opt_in.founder`.

instructions.name: set_launch_config_enabled
docs: Switch an allowed config on or off for new approvals and launches.

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: Pause or resume launches and payouts. The payout key may only pause payouts.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin, or the payout key (pause payouts only).

instructions.name: set_payout_config
docs: Set (or clear, with two zero addresses) the payout key and payout wallet.

instructions.name: transfer_founder
docs: The founder hands the seat to a new key; both sign.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not allowed to do this

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: InvalidAddress
errors.msg: an address is zero, not executable, or otherwise not usable here

errors.name: NoPendingAdmin
errors.msg: no admin transfer is pending

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: LaunchesPaused
errors.msg: launches are paused

errors.name: PayoutsPaused
errors.msg: payouts are paused

errors.name: PayoutsNotConfigured
errors.msg: opted-in payouts are not configured

errors.name: PayoutKeyNotSeparate
errors.msg: the payout key must differ from the admin and the dev wallet, and the payout wallet from the payout key and the admin

errors.name: LaunchConfigDisabled
errors.msg: this launch config is disabled

errors.name: LaunchConfigMismatch
errors.msg: the DBC config, quote mint or launch config do not belong together

errors.name: QuoteMintNotAllowed
errors.msg: quote mint must be classic SPL Token with no mint or freeze authority and 6 to 9 decimals

errors.name: ConfigFeeClaimer
errors.msg: config fee_claimer must be the dev wallet (FEE_RECIPIENT)

errors.name: ConfigLeftoverReceiver
errors.msg: config leftover_receiver must be the dev wallet (FEE_RECIPIENT)

errors.name: ConfigTokenType
errors.msg: config must create classic SPL coins

errors.name: ConfigDecimalsOrSupply
errors.msg: config must create 6-decimal coins with a fixed supply of exactly 1,000,000,000

errors.name: ConfigCollectFeeMode
errors.msg: config must collect fees in the quote token

errors.name: ConfigFee
errors.msg: config fee must be flat, without dynamic fee, and at most MAX_TRADE_FEE_NUMERATOR

errors.name: ConfigFeeSplit
errors.msg: config must give the creator (city) exactly REQUIRED_CREATOR_FEE_PERCENT of the trading fee

errors.name: ConfigMetadataMutable
errors.msg: config must make coin metadata immutable

errors.name: ConfigLiquidityLock
errors.msg: config must lock all graduated liquidity permanently, 50/50, with no vesting

errors.name: ConfigMigration
errors.msg: config must graduate to a DAMM v2 customizable pool with a flat quote-only fee of at most 2% and no dynamic, scheduled or compounding fee

errors.name: ConfigMigrationFee
errors.msg: config must not charge a graduation fee

errors.name: ConfigVesting
errors.msg: config must not lock or vest coins for anyone

errors.name: ConfigLaunchFee
errors.msg: config launch fee is above MAX_POOL_CREATION_FEE_LAMPORTS

errors.name: BadName
errors.msg: name must be 1 to 32 bytes with no control characters

errors.name: BadSymbol
errors.msg: symbol must be 1 to 10 characters of A-Z and 0-9

errors.name: BadExpiry
errors.msg: expiry must be in the future and at most APPROVAL_MAX_SECS away

errors.name: ApprovalExpired
errors.msg: this approval has expired

errors.name: CoinAlreadyLaunched
errors.msg: this city already has a coin

errors.name: WrongFounder
errors.msg: signer is not this coin's founder

errors.name: PoolCreatorMismatch
errors.msg: the DBC pool does not belong to this coin

errors.name: WrongPool
errors.msg: the DAMM v2 pool is not this coin's pair

errors.name: WrongPosition
errors.msg: the position is not in this pool or not held by this coin

errors.name: WrongRewardsConfig
errors.msg: the rewards config is not this coin's Holders-only config in the coin's quote token

errors.name: WrongRewardsVault
errors.msg: the rewards vault is not this coin's derived rewards vault

errors.name: DestinationMismatch
errors.msg: the payout destination does not match the founder's agreed destination

errors.name: OptInFounderMismatch
errors.msg: the opt-in was signed by a previous founder

errors.name: PayoutTooSoon
errors.msg: the last payout for this coin was less than 24 hours ago

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Zero address means a pending transfer was cancelled.

types.name: Approval
docs: One per city while an approval is pending. Seeds: `["approval", city_id LE]`.
Closed (rent back to `rent_payer`) by `launch` or `revoke_approval`.

fields.name: founder
docs: The only wallet that may launch this city's coin.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: The allowed DBC config (quote token, target, fees) the coin must use.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives this account's rent when it is closed.

fields.name: name
docs: On-chain coin name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: The city ticker (A-Z0-9).

types.name: Coin
docs: One per city, for ever (there is no close instruction). Seeds: `["coin", city_id LE]`.
This PDA is the DBC pool creator, so the creator half of the trading fee
belongs to the city. It signs only: the DBC launch, DBC
`claim_creator_trading_fee`, DAMM v2 `claim_position_fee`, and SPL transfers
out of its holders pot and founder vault to the destinations each
instruction pins.

fields.name: founder
docs: Receives the founder share; changes only by `transfer_founder`.

fields.name: mint
docs: The coin mint (created by DBC).

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: The DBC virtual pool; its `creator` field equals this PDA.

fields.name: holders_accrued
docs: Lifetime amount booked into the holders pot by harvests.

fields.name: holders_forwarded
docs: Lifetime amount moved from the pot to the rewards vault.

fields.name: founder_accrued
docs: Lifetime amount booked into the founder vault by harvests.

fields.name: founder_claimed
docs: Lifetime amount claimed by the founder.

fields.name: founder_paid_out
docs: Lifetime amount sent by opted-in payouts.

fields.name: payout_seq
docs: Payout counter; never resets, so `(city_id, seq)` is a unique receipt key.

fields.name: last_payout_at
docs: Unix time of the last payout (24-hour cooldown). Kept here so revoking
and opting in again cannot reset it.

fields.name: source
docs: 0 = curve (DBC), 1 = graduated pool (DAMM v2).

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: One per allowed Meteora DBC config. Seeds: `["launch_config", dbc_config]`.
The economic fields are copies of the (immutable) DBC config for display;
the program re-validates the DBC config itself at every launch.

fields.name: migration_quote_threshold
docs: Raise target F in quote raw units.

fields.name: trade_fee_numerator
docs: DBC fee numerator out of 1,000,000,000.

fields.name: pool_creation_fee
docs: Launch fee in lamports.

fields.name: enabled
docs: The admin can switch a config off for new approvals and launches.

types.name: Launchpad
docs: One per program. Seeds: `["launchpad"]`.
The dev wallet is not stored: it is the constant `FEE_RECIPIENT`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Approves launches, allow-lists Meteora configs, sets the payout key and
wallet, pauses. Holds no power over any token.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Second step of an admin transfer. Zero address = nothing pending.

fields.name: payout_authority
docs: Key allowed to run opted-in founder payouts. Zero = payouts are off.

fields.name: payout_destination
docs: Wallet whose quote-token account receives opted-in payouts. Zero = off.

fields.name: rewards_program
docs: The `vicinity_rewards` program id. Set once at init, never changeable.

fields.name: launches_paused
docs: Blocks `launch`.

fields.name: payouts_paused
docs: Blocks `payout_founder_fees`.

types.name: PayoutOptIn
docs: One per coin while the founder is opted in to payouts. Seeds: `["payout_opt_in", coin]`.

fields.name: founder
docs: Who signed; must still equal `coin.founder` at every payout.

fields.name: agreed_destination
docs: Copy of `launchpad.payout_destination` when the founder signed. Every
payout must match it AND the current setting, so a settings change can
never redirect this founder's money.

fields.name: ref_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain reference (partner customer id plus salt).
Never a name, X handle or bank number.

types.name: PoolFeesStruct
docs: Information regarding fee charges
trading_fee = amount * trade_fee_numerator / denominator
protocol_fee = trading_fee * protocol_fee_percentage / 100
referral_fee = protocol_fee * referral_percentage / 100

types.name: RewardInfo
docs: Stores the state relevant for tracking liquidity mining rewards

constants.name: APPROVAL_MAX_SECS
docs: An approval lasts at most 30 days.

constants.name: COIN_DECIMALS
docs: Decimals of every Vicinity coin.

constants.name: COIN_SUPPLY_RAW
docs: 1,000,000,000 coins at 6 decimals. Every Vicinity coin has exactly this
supply, minted once by DBC with the mint authority removed.

constants.name: FEE_RECIPIENT
docs: The dev wallet. Every platform fee goes here: Meteora configs are only
accepted when they name it as `fee_claimer` and `leftover_receiver`. It is a
constant on purpose: no admin key can redirect platform fees, and changing it
needs a program upgrade (the upgrade multisig). Devnet uses the same wallet.

constants.name: MAX_MIGRATED_POOL_FEE_BPS
docs: Highest fee the graduated DAMM v2 pool may charge: 2%.

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Longest on-chain coin name (Metaplex limit), in bytes.

constants.name: MAX_POOL_CREATION_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: Highest launch fee (DBC `pool_creation_fee`): 0.5 SOL.

constants.name: MAX_SYMBOL_LEN
docs: Longest ticker (Metaplex limit), in bytes of A-Z0-9.

constants.name: MAX_TRADE_FEE_NUMERATOR
docs: Highest curve trading fee a config may charge: 2.00% (DBC fee denominator
1,000,000,000). DBC's own minimum is 0.25%.

constants.name: METADATA_URI_PREFIX
docs: Every coin's metadata URL is this prefix, the coin's mint address and ".json".

constants.name: MIN_QUOTE_DECIMALS
docs: Lowest and highest decimals an allowed quote token may have (WSOL has 9,
$VICINITY 6).

constants.name: PAYOUT_COOLDOWN_SECS
docs: At most one opted-in payout per coin per 24 hours.

constants.name: REQUIRED_CREATOR_FEE_PERCENT
docs: The city (pool creator) gets this share of the non-Meteora trading fee; the
dev wallet (partner) gets the rest.

constants.name: REQUIRED_CREATOR_LOCKED_LP_PERCENT
docs: Share of the graduated pool's liquidity locked for ever in the Coin PDA's
position.

constants.name: REQUIRED_PARTNER_LOCKED_LP_PERCENT
docs: Share of the graduated pool's liquidity locked for ever in the dev wallet's
position.
